context.body: The bounded canonical source is Exodus 12:33–42; its local speaker, audience, sequence, and literary form remain controlling evidence.
context.label: Narrative or literary frame

observations.body: The Egyptians urge departure, the people carry unleavened dough and requested goods, and a mixed multitude goes with them.
observations.label: Israel leaves Egypt with a mixed company: action

observations.body: the night is kept as a vigil for the LORD.
observations.label: Israel leaves Egypt with a mixed company: response

payload.posture: Read Exodus 12:33–42 as a people under egypt evidence before carrying it into another source.
payload.tension: The departing body is wider than one genealogical label, yet later covenant boundaries are not settled by this sentence alone.
payload.title: Israel leaves Egypt with a mixed company
